description: Vehicle trajectories collected by a swarm of drones in Athens, Greece is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Jasso Espadaler-Clapés, Taylor Mordan (MobiLysis). This dataset contains highly detailed, georeferenced vehicle trajectories collected by a swarm of eight drones operating over the city centre of Athens, Greece. In total, it includes more than 800,000 unique trajectories captured across 10 distinct urban locations. Coverage: national (GR); the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
